description.value: Manley Creek Park is a nature reserve managed by the Cowichan Valley Regional District on southern Vancouver Island. As a protected natural area, it offers cyclists a quiet stop amid BC coastal forest and riparian habitat. The park is part of CVRD's regional parks network, which preserves ecologically sensitive lands across the valley.
